title.narrative: Emergency Winter Assistance for schools and IDPs in the northwest of Syria

description.narrative: Through the Start fund, we will be able to ease the suffering of the targeted people and secure some of their needs by providing them with the most important materials (Fuel, and cash) which will improve their well-being situation.

With the support of Start Fund, Lead Agency and Agency 1 hope to replace some of the gaps left by the severe weather's effects on the IDPs camps and tents, where Agency 1 has field workers, as we are making every effort to lessen the effects of the cold weather. By CWG recommendations, we will offer 410 families winter cash assistance of $150 per HH (or the equivalent amount in Turkish Lira) in Harim, rural Idlib, winter NFIs (fuel for educational institutions in the Afrin district of rural Aleppo). Tight collaboration with local actors, such as the Islamic Relief Organization, UN clusters, WHO, camp management, local councils, and Turkish authorities, will prevent duplication and strengthen the response plan. To reach more beneficiaries, particularly children, women, and older people, the field team will be included in two offices in rural Idlib and Aleppo. The Agency 1 Turkish Relations Officer is coordinating with the stakeholders from the Turkish side as well to benefit more from this response. Winter cash distribution criteria: - More than one family in the shelter and extreme poverty - HHs headed by women - A head of household with a disability with children with little financial means - A family headed by a child without guardians (not child labor), separated and unaccompanied children - The presence of pregnant and lactating women in the family without the support of the extended family - Unaccompanied women without protection (widow, divorced) - A family without a father or mother or both and does not have a breadwinner child labour. - A disability or disability that prevents a person from working and earning money - Unaccompanied older people. - A family that includes a person with a disability with no source of income - Older people with chronic diseases and do not have stable income
